method.cold: fresh browser profile per run; each response delayed by its size at 50 Mbit/s after fetching (parallel downloads overlap, so this approximates a shared link rather than shaping traffic)
method.warm: model files cached; a new page per run (as on a repeat visit), so the model is loaded from cache each time; pipeline driven through a test hook
method.ui: one run per dataset through the real interface (paste, click, wait until the themes render) to include rendering in timing and long tasks
method.memory: peak proportional set size (PSS, shared pages split) of the browser and all its processes, sampled every 100 ms
method.longTasks: PerformanceObserver longtask entries on the page (main thread) during the run
method.backend: WebAssembly (headless browsers have no GPU adapter)
method.maxNotes: 500 notes: the 246 unique dataset notes repeated; timing only

budgets.measured: measured by hand with Safari Web Inspector

budgets.budget: Main-thread tasks over 200 ms (every run, including the interface runs)

quality.check: Demo sample: 4–8 themes in every warm run
Demo sample: mean ARI over all 10 warm runs ≥ 0.6
Demo sample: worst mean ARI over 3 consecutive runs (for information)
